text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
「おれが悪かった」という言葉を信用すると
「ウソだけどな」と裏切られるかもしれません。
text.official_en: The problem, however, is that today’s apology may simply be a disguise in which tomorrow’s betrayal is clothed.
text.real_en: If you trust his “I was wrong,” he may turn around and say, “Just kidding!” and betray you again.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとバッツは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Bartz are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとバッツは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Bartz are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp: いつでも真剣勝負
text.official_en: Take each challenge seriously.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
かけがえのない仲間のガラフまでもが、
命を捨てて、バッツたちを守りました。
text.official_en: Even Galuf, whose presence was crucial to the party, gave up his life so that the others would be spared.

text.jp:
かつて打ち破った相手でも、侮ることなく
真剣な気迫をもって臨むのですね。
text.official_en: You choose to reward their determination and resiliency, rather than hold them in contempt for their lack of prowess.
text.real_en: Even if you have defeated someone before, you would never underestimate them, facing them with all your fighting spirit.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
しかしギルガメッシュは、バッツたちを
かばって犠牲となります。
text.official_en: Eventually, Gilgamesh sacrificed himself so that Bartz and his companions could live.

text.jp:
その配下ギルガメッシュは、バッツたちに
幾度負けても、しぶとく挑んできました。
text.official_en: They also learned of his subordinate Gilgamesh, who fought with vigor no matter how many times he was bested.
text.real_en: His subordinate Gilgamesh stubbornly challenged Bartz and his friends again and again, no matter how often he lost.

text.jp: それは、四つの心が無を終わらせた異界の記憶――
text.official_en: It is a world that was wrested from the clutches of nothingness by four brave souls.
text.real_en: These are memories of another world where four hearts put an end to the void—

text.jp:
たとえ敵でも、いさぎよく負けを認めれば
受け入れてもよいですが……
text.official_en: There is nothing wrong, in and of itself, with accepting a foe who gracefully admits defeat.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
もしもバッツたちに機会があれば、
きっと素晴らしい仲間になれたでしょう。
text.official_en: Should you have chanced upon Bartz and his companions, you would have made a wonderful addition to their party.
text.real_en: If Bartz and his companions had had the chance, they and Gilgamesh might have become wonderful allies.

text.jp:
オメガや神竜といった究極の敵への挑戦を
ガラフの想いが見守ってくれます。
text.official_en: In a similar vein, Bartz confronted puissant foes such as Omega and Shinryu while Galuf watched over him.
text.real_en: Galuf’s hopes will watch over you as you challenge ultimate foes such as Omega and Shinryu.

text.jp:
ガラフは孫のクルルに希望を託しており、
バッツたちは四つの心を重ねて戦います。
text.official_en: In much the same way, Krile took up the gage when Galuf could carry on no more, and she assumed his role as the fourth warrior of light.
text.real_en: Galuf entrusted his hopes to his granddaughter Krile, and Bartz and his friends fought with four hearts united.

text.jp:
クリスタルが豊かな恵みをもたらし
国々がともに栄える世界。
text.official_en: Before that struggle, the world was blessed with the crystals’ bounty, and its nations thrived.
text.real_en: A world where the Crystals bestowed nature’s bounty and nations flourished together.

text.jp: チョコボと旅をつづける
text.official_en: Continue traveling with your chocobo.

text.jp:
バッツの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
バッツも、はじめはふたりと別れましたが
ボコにたしなめられ、助けに向かいました。
text.official_en: Bartz, too, wished to tread his own path, and bid his farewell to both Lenna and Galuf before Boko convinced him otherwise.

text.jp:
一緒に戦った仲間なら、嘆き悲しむより
限界を越えての挑戦を望むでしょう。
text.official_en: You believe that, rather than mourning the loss of your comrades, breaking new ground will best honor their memory.
text.real_en: Your companions would probably want you to keep pushing past your limits rather than only mourning them.

text.jp:
事情はわからなくても、人の力になる。
思いやりから、縁がつながります。
text.official_en: You would lend a hand out of the goodness of your heart. It is from such acts of kindness that connections are made.

text.jp:
何に出くわそうと迷わず、わが道をゆく。
それも立派な生き方です。
text.official_en: You walk your path to the very end, no matter what obstructs it. That is a commendable philosophy indeed.

text.jp:
何度も撃退したギルガメッシュが
また襲いかかってきたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to strike down your foe time after time, only for them to redouble their efforts, what would you do?
text.real_en: If Gilgamesh attacked again after you had driven him off so many times... what would you do?

text.jp:
偶然の出会いが、冒険のきっかけに……
彼らはみな、風の異変を感じていました。
text.official_en: A chance meeting—or a shift in the wind—can spark a grand adventure, much as it did for Bartz and his companions.
text.real_en: A chance meeting can set an adventure in motion... They had all sensed that something was wrong with the wind.

text.jp: 反省するなら許す
text.official_en: Forgive them as long as they see the error of their ways.

text.jp:
嘘偽りのない闘志をぶつけあうことで
心が通じあうこともあるでしょう。
text.official_en: Perhaps an exchange of raw, emotional blows will foster a new understanding between you two.

text.jp:
大切な仲間の犠牲を嘆いても、遺された想いを
無にしないよう守るのですね。
text.official_en: Rather than grieve for your fallen comrades, you would do your utmost to prove that their sacrifices were not in vain.
text.real_en: You would grieve for those precious friends, but protect the hopes they left behind so that their sacrifice would not be in vain.

text.jp: 少女の力になりたい
text.official_en: Help the young woman.

text.jp:
彼の名は、バッツ……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That traveler’s name is Bartz, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Bartz... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
彼らはやがて、クリスタルの破壊を狙う
暗黒魔道士エクスデスの脅威を知ります。
text.official_en: After journeying together for some time, Bartz’s group came to know of the dark warlock Exdeath and the threat that he posed.
text.real_en: Eventually they learned of the threat posed by the dark mage Exdeath, who sought to destroy the Crystals.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp:
悲しみはなかったことに……無理からぬ
想いですが、無の力は危険です。
text.official_en: To reduce a tragedy and sorrow to nothingness may be understandable, but it can also be quite dangerous.
text.real_en: To act as if the grief never happened... That is understandable, but the power of the void is dangerous.

text.jp: 悲しみをなかったことにする
text.official_en: Forget such things happened.
text.real_en: Pretend the sadness never happened.

text.jp: 振り向かずに挑戦する
text.official_en: Press on without looking back.

text.jp:
敵として出会った者たちが、戦いによって
絆を結び、好敵手として理解しあう。
text.official_en: For you, those who share the same battlefield—regardless of the side they occupy—also share ties that should be honored.
text.real_en: Two people who meet as enemies may forge a bond through battle and come to understand each other as worthy rivals.

text.jp:
無の侵蝕に挑む異界の幻影　バッツ
次元の狭間を越えて、暁を告げる風。
text.official_en:
Gentle Breeze Bartz
A veritable zephyr that wafts twixt dimensions to herald the dawn.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision who challenges the encroaching void: Bartz. A wind that crosses the Rift to herald the dawn.

text.jp:
無を欲したエクスデスですら、最期には
無に呑まれ、すべてを失いました。
text.official_en: Exdeath sought to return all to nothingness, but ultimately he was consumed by the void he so coveted.

text.jp:
王女レナと老戦士ガラフ、そしてバッツは
クリスタルの危機をめぐる冒険に旅立ちます。
text.official_en: Princess Lenna and the warrior Galuf joined him on his quest, and upon their shoulders would ultimately rest the fate of the crystals.
text.real_en: Princess Lenna, the old warrior Galuf and Bartz set out on a journey amid a crisis threatening the Crystals.

text.jp:
相棒であるチョコボのボコと
世界を旅する若者がいました。
text.official_en: The tale begins with a young man who traveled the world astride his chocobo named Boko.
text.real_en: A young man journeyed across the world with his partner Boko, a chocobo.

text.jp:
自分たちの旅を終わらせないために
ともに旅した仲間が犠牲になったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were your comrades, with whom you had shared countless experiences, forced to give up their lives so that you could continue on, what would you do?

text.jp: 託された希望を守る
text.official_en: Keep their hopes and dreams alive.

text.jp: 記憶のない老人を助ける
text.official_en: Save the old amnesiac.

text.jp: 認めあい仲間にさそう
text.official_en: Try to recruit them to your cause.
text.real_en: Acknowledge one another and invite him to join you.

text.jp:
隕石が落ちた地で、見知らぬ少女と
記憶のない老人に出会ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to investigate the site of a crashed meteorite, and there find a young woman and an old amnesiac in trouble, what would you do?

text.jp:
隕石とともに現れた老戦士ガラフは
バッツの亡き父の戦友だったのです。
text.official_en: The man to whom Bartz lent his aid turned out to be Galuf, a warrior who once fought beside Bartz’s deceased father.
